name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: PR closes its source issue on merge: the shipped implementer agent's accept-path gh pr create now embeds a --body with the GitHub closing keyword Closes #<source-issue-number> (number from the ## Inputs work order / ROBUSTNESS gh issue view fetch; omitted when unresolvable), so GitHub auto-closes the source issue ONLY on merge (propose=stays open, auto-merge=closes) and the PR's closingIssuesReferences is populated (repairing supersede-on-retry + verify-integrate orphaned-PR detection, both silent no-ops without it). The auto-maintainer label, never-merge rule, worktree lifecycle, reject path (gh issue close), and Handoff contract are UNCHANGED. This is an agent .md prose change (not a SKILL.md; no skill-creator). spec.md + contract.md were authored/committed by the dispatcher spec-update phase at 52c0819; the housekeep doc baseline was re-anchored in-scope (spec.md 336->353).
